home.story.case.start.t: 以 PD-L1 与 KN035 为起点，让对分子的理解逐步沉淀为设计依据，让下一轮实验有更明确的方向

home.story.items.affinity.body.t: MoleculeOS 对 KN035 的 2,432 种单点替换进行结合亲和力预测。在界面候选中，V109L、Q116M 与 T105L 排名靠前。对这三个候选分别生成 5 个复合物结构样本，进一步检查预测界面

home.story.items.affinity.lead.t: 结合模型评分、理化性质、文献知识，寻找可能改善结合的突变

home.story.items.affinity.title.t:

都有据可依

home.story.items.denovo.body.t: 参考 PD-L1 的预测表位，生成长度为 60–100 aa 的候选。展示的 3 个候选在预测复合物中均接触 6 个指定设计热点，分别覆盖 19 个参考表位残基中的 14–18 个

home.story.items.denovo.lead.t: 基于靶点序列，也可按需指定结合区域与设计要求，从零生成全新的结合蛋白

home.story.items.denovo.note.t: 注：设计效果依赖于使用者对模型的熟悉程度与实践经验。仅采用默认参数和较低计算投入，不保证获得有效命中；候选分子仍需进一步筛选与实验验证。   如有抗体、VHH 或环肽设计需求，欢迎联系合作

home.story.items.denovo.title.t:

home.story.items.mmetrics.body.t: MMetrics 把帮助理解、分析蛋白的高价值数据汇在同一视图：描述性数据涵盖同源蛋白、酶的活性位点、抗体抗原复合物的 CDR 与表位，以及氢键、π-π 堆积、范德华接触、盐桥、π-阳离子等相互作用；模型计算数据提供突变打分等。在这个复合物中，它标出 PD-L1 的 19 个表位残基、KN035 的 18 个互补位残基和 44 条相互作用记录，每一条都对应结构上的位置

home.story.items.mmetrics.lead.t: 关联序列、结构、图表，整体结构与局部界面信息以多角度呈现，辅助用户评估与设计

home.story.items.mmetrics.title.t:

home.story.items.stability.body.t: 在保留两对二硫键相关位点的约束下，对入选突变开展多维评估。综合本次评分与风险筛查，V109L 被列为优先验证候选；Q116M 提示潜在的甲硫氨酸氧化风险，T105L 的进化适应度表现较弱。让候选选择同时考虑结合潜力与开发风险，为后续实验提供更完整的依据

home.story.items.stability.lead.t: 对亲和力初筛后的变体开展结构、序列与进化适应度评估，并扫描风险基序，综合考量结合潜力与开发隐患

home.story.items.stability.title.t: 兼顾亲和力与可开发性，推荐最平衡的优化

home.story.items.mmetrics.body.t: MMetrics brings high-value data for understanding and analyzing a protein into one view. Descriptive data covers homologous proteins, enzyme active sites, antibody–antigen CDRs and epitopes, and interactions such as hydrogen bonds, π-π stacking, van der Waals contacts, salt bridges and π-cation; model-computed data adds mutation scores and more. On this complex it marks 19 epitope residues on PD-L1 and 18 paratope residues on KN035, with 44 interaction records, each tied to a position on the structure

home.story.case.start.t: Starting from PD-L1 and KN035, turn your understanding of the molecule, step by step, into a basis for design, and give the next round of experiments a clearer direction

home.story.items.affinity.body.t: MoleculeOS predicts binding affinity for all 2,432 single-point substitutions on KN035. Among the interface candidates, V109L, Q116M and T105L rank highest. For each of the three, five complex structure samples were generated to examine the predicted interface more closely

home.story.items.denovo.body.t: Taking the predicted epitope on PD-L1 as a reference, candidates 60–100 aa in length were generated. In the predicted complexes, all three candidates shown contact all 6 designated design hotspots, and cover 14–18 of the 19 reference epitope residues

home.story.items.stability.body.t: With the sites involved in the two disulfide bonds held fixed, the selected mutations were assessed along several dimensions. Combining this round's scores with a risk screen, V109L is ranked as the priority candidate for validation; Q116M flags a potential methionine oxidation risk, and T105L shows weaker evolutionary fitness. Weighing binding potential against developability risk gives the next round of experiments a more complete basis

home.story.items.stability.lead.t: Variants that passed the affinity screen are assessed for structural, sequence and evolutionary fitness and scanned for risk motifs, so that binding potential is weighed against developability concerns

home.story.items.structure.body.t: Enter the PD-L1 and KN035 sequences, and MMFold generates five complex structure samples. Using the structures together with their predicted confidence, examine the binding interface to establish a starting point for further analysis and antibody optimization
